query:
SELECT
            a.id as "id?",
            i.id as "auth_id?",
            COALESCE(a.full_name, a.label, i.full_name) AS "full_name?",
            r.label AS "room_name?",
            r.id AS "room_id?"
        FROM
            accounts_people a
            FULL JOIN identities i ON i.id = a.auth_id
            LEFT JOIN res_leases l ON a.id = l.tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN res_rooms r ON l.room_id = r.id WHERE TRUE   ORDER BY (a.id IS NULL) DESC, (i.id IS NULL) DESC, r.label DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2
